fato_historico: 1869: Japan's Edo society class system is abolished as part of the Meiji Restoration reforms.
energia_do_dia: The stars align to support your personal growth. Much like ancient structures evolving into new eras of progress, today is a beautiful moment to shed old layers that no longer serve your ambitious spirit. Consider this an invitation to refresh your inner landscape and build a future that feels authentically yours, leaving behind rigid expectations for newfound flexibility.
frase_do_dia: True strength lies in the courage to release the old and welcome the new.
significado_numero: Represents the manifestation of wisdom and the flow of abundance.
conselho: Prioritize your peace and allow yourself the grace of a fresh start today.
